audit.why: Even lane at 51.67% over 6565 games. Sylas takes level 1 on Chain Lash plus Petricite Burst autos; Katarina owns levels 2-5 short trades; level 6 flips to Sylas because Hijack copies Death Lotus; first item flips back; two items goes to Sylas on sustain plus a stolen ult every fight.
audit.corrected: Level chart in the full layer was all 'Skill' while the content layer win[] and the packet levelChart both read Sylas/Katarina per row. Aligned the full layer to the content layer and rewrote every why to match.

audit.why: Spikes: level 3 dagger strings, level 6 Death Lotus (75/60/45s) versus Sylas Hijack (80/55/30s), first item burst-reset, two items where Sylas out-brawls.
audit.corrected: Spikes array already grounded in Hijack, Kingslayer and Abduct; left intact.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digits and the E was described only as 'Dash into chain-stun'. The Bouncing Blade grounding interaction versus Sylas's two dashes was never stated.
audit.why: Sylas has two dash abilities — Kingslayer (W, 400 range lunge) and Abscond/Abduct (E) — and the owner kit flags Bouncing Blade (Q) with grounding, which shuts both off. Death Lotus is flagged channel, so Abduct's pull cancels it.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written in: Abscond/Abduct 13/12/11/10/9s, Kingslayer 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s, Chain Lash 10/9/8/7/6s. Lotus-cancel interaction stated in dosFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string verbatim, dosFull[0].d was the cooldowns line pasted under an unrelated title.
audit.why: Lint flagged COPY_PASTE_BLEED on two of them; the third is the same defect class.
audit.corrected: All three bodies rewritten to match their own titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[10].t reads 'Gank for HER' about Sylas, who is male.
audit.why: champ-gender.js does not list sylas as female.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the correct pronoun and grounded in Sylas having no disengage once Abscond is spent.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - E Shunpo (second use) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

edits.after: Off your daggers you have no reset engine and no exit — Sylas Abducts in, heals off Kingslayer, and the brawl is his to grind.

edits.before: Sylas wins by landing Abscond / Abduct, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Sylas wins by Hijacking your Death Lotus, healing through your burst with Kingslayer, and dragging every trade past three seconds.

edits.before: Carry through chain reactions — one kill is three; your job is the first domino and the discipline to wait for it.
edits.after: Carry by killing him while Hijack is spent — a Sylas without a stolen ult is a melee mage your dagger strings delete.

edits.before: Gank for HER: any CC your jungler lands is a full string plus lotus — ping the dagger-banked windows and watch the chain react.
edits.after: Gank for HIM: Sylas has no disengage once Abscond is spent, so any jungler CC becomes a full string plus Lotus and a reset.
